name: video-meme
description: Video toolkit: HyperFrames (HTML → MP4), Remotion (React → MP4) and FFmpeg post-production.

scripts.hf:check: . scripts/env.sh && cd hyperframes && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.223 check
scripts.hf:render: . scripts/env.sh && cd hyperframes && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.223 render -o ../out/hyperframes.mp4
scripts.rm:render: . scripts/env.sh && cd remotion && npx remotion render MemeIntro ../out/remotion.mp4
